answer: Charge identity rent, demurrage-style: every registered agent pays a small fee each epoch, say 2 POA, taken from its stake before rewards land, and a key whose stake hits zero is retired. An honest agent covers rent from real earnings. A farmer who mints a dune of 5,000 sleeper keys to wait for a vote or lottery must pay 10,000 POA every epoch just to keep them alive, so idle clones bleed value like sand off a ridge. Signing a key costs one quill stroke; holding it costs rent.
